run_challenge_submission: run the script to create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file from results
write_is2re_relaxations_from_traj: write IS2RE relaxation predictions from trajectory files in a directory to a compressed NPZ submission file
write_is2re_relaxations_hybrid: write IS2RE predictions from hybrid S2EF NPZ prediction files combining force and energy models
write_predictions_from_npz: write general challenge predictions by loading an NPZ file and prefixing keys with challenge_
run_main_with_args: run the main function with argparse args to generate a submission file for S2EF or IS2RE tasks
